recorded_interpretation.result: DESCRIPTIVE ONLY, evaluated as of 2026-09-25T00:00:00Z using saved observations. The publication window is 2026-09-20 through 2026-09-23 inclusive in workspace UTC. All six assigned posts are on X with primary job Bookmarks / Saves; five have a known bookmarks_per_1k value. Short posts: 8, 10, 12 bookmarks per 1,000 impressions (n=3; median 10). Checklists: 15, 21 (n=2 measured of 3 assigned; median 18). The observed median difference is +8 per 1,000, or 1.8x (+80%); this is a sample comparison, not causal lift or statistical significance. Each saved snapshot has 1,000 impressions and was observed at 2026-09-24T12:00:00Z. Short-post snapshots are 96 hours after publication; checklist snapshots are 24 hours after publication. Checklist post_299994e79d3a has an unknown bookmark count in metric_d3099747c4fd and is excluded from the median, not treated as zero. Short-post provenance: post_3baad0606b8e/metric_b48a35fe8c3d, post_a92109ffbd33/metric_0562c00bcdd8, post_222e56729a1d/metric_f2ea76422fb7. Measured checklist provenance: post_54baf92da361/metric_5b0a5b36e5ff, post_808da87830e0/metric_32ee74f3da91. The as-of cutoff applies to observation timestamps; this uses current saved experiment membership and does not reconstruct historical record revisions.
recorded_interpretation.learning: Checklists show a promising association with saves in this fictional QA sample, but the format advantage remains unproven. Only two checklist measurements are complete; missing data, unequal observation ages, different topics and publication dates, and no randomized control prevent attributing the gap to format. The measured checklists concern handoff ownership, while the short posts cover question capture and checklist reuse, so topic utility could contribute. The named-owner handoff-log checklist is the strongest observed individual post at 21 bookmarks per 1,000; it is a candidate topic for a follow-up comparison, not proof that all checklists work better. Bookmarks do not establish actual process reuse, trust, leads or sales. Keep both formats in testing and do not turn this finding into a permanent format or voice preference.
recorded_interpretation.next_action: Recommend a matched follow-up before shifting the content mix. Plan three topic-matched pairs on X, one checklist and one short post per pair, with Bookmarks / Saves as the primary job and comparable source-backed utility. Include a handoff-ownership pair; balance comparable posting slots and vary format order across pairs. Prespecify bookmarks per 1,000 impressions measured exactly 96 hours after each publication as the primary comparison for both formats; collect timestamped bookmark and impression counts for every post. Compare within-pair differences and format medians, reporting all sample sizes and missing values; this small follow-up is exploratory, not an automatic proof threshold. For the existing missing checklist count, only use a verifiable timestamped measurement if later supplied, retaining the original unknown snapshot and keeping later observations outside this as-of result. This action is a saved recommendation only: no drafts, publication or observation changes are authorized by this analysis.
